**Primary entity: Aztec** — 114 blob transactions from 37 different Aztec addresses. All of these transactions consist of a single, completely empty (zero-data) blob.

**Scale:** Empty blob submissions began sporadically in March 2024, then exploded to ~1,300–1,600 per day starting November 19, 2025 — totaling 190,250 empty blobs on mainnet to date. The `dim_block_blob_submitter` table only covers blocks up to ~25.4M, so the total entity-attributed count is higher than the 169 captured above.

The known labeled entities that submitted blob transactions in these blocks: **Base**, **Unichain**, **World Chain**, and **Aztec**.

## Key Findings

**Correlation is weak but statistically significant:**
- **Pearson r = 0.24** (p < 1e-93)
- **Spearman ρ = 0.29** (p < 1e-140)

This means block size explains only ~6% of the variance in propagation time. Other factors (geographic distance, client diversity, network congestion) dominate.

**Effect size:**
- Blocks < 50 KB: **~1,531 ms** avg propagation
- Blocks ≥ 50 KB: **~2,042 ms** avg propagation
- Going from the smallest to largest blocks adds ~700–800 ms on average

**Size distribution is heavily skewed:**
- Most blocks are small (< 300 KB); blocks above ~400 KB are rare
- The very largest blocks (> 500 KB) have too few samples for reliable stats

**Chart:** `relay_collapse.png` at `http://127.0.0.1:2480/api/v1/storage/files/59a30d6156c8/88ac13c7-64cb-4b34-a68f-76a5e5888b92/relay_collapse.png`

---

### Exact Window

The circuit breaker cascade ran **Dec 4, 2025, ~02:50 UTC → ~05:00 UTC** (~2 hours), with the deepest trough at **03:20–04:40 UTC**.

### Severity — Hourly Relay Deliveries (mainnet)

| Metric | Baseline (Dec 1-2 avg) | Crash (03:00-04:59) | Drop |
|---|---|---|---|
| Relay deliveries/hr | 5,160 | 1,746 | **−66%** |
| Unique slots covered/hr | 276 | 78 | **−72%** |
| Active relays/bucket | 7–8 | 3–7 | |

### 10-minute nadir (03:30 UTC) — only **7 unique slots** had any relay delivery (normal: 40–45). At 03:50: **5 slots**.

### Per-relay impact at the worst hour (04:00 UTC)

| Relay | Normal hourly volume | Crash hour | Drop |
|---|---|---|---|
| EthGas | ~96 | **0** | **100%** |
| Agnostic Gnosis | ~324 | 36 | **89%** |
| Titan Relay | ~1,392 | 300 | **78%** |
| Flashbots | ~216 | 51 | **76%** |
| Ultra Sound | ~1,940 | 564 | **71%** |
| BloXroute Regulated | ~750 | 270 | **64%** |
| BloXroute Max Profit | ~990 | 380 | **62%** |
| Aestus | ~144 | 48 | **67%** |

All 8 relays were hit simultaneously — consistent with a common upstream trigger that cascaded through circuit breakers. Recovery was gradual; volumes returned to normal by ~06:00 UTC. No abnormally large MEV payments preceded the event (max was ~0.15 ETH), suggesting the trip was not triggered by a single outsized bid but likely by a relay-infrastructure or network-level fault.

Here is the quantified analysis based on `fct_block_head` and `fct_block_mev_head` on mainnet.

## Timeline

| Phase | Window (UTC) | Relay % | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Precursor** | Dec 3 ~22:00 | 75% | Brief dip from ~92% baseline, recovered |
| **Onset** | Dec 4 ~02:45 | 69.6% | Relay delivery started to fall off |
| **Nadir** | **Dec 4 03:45** | **9.1%** | Only **5 of 55** blocks came via relays |
| **Worst hours** | Dec 4 03:00–04:59 | ~32–34% | Both hours with ~77 relay blocks → ~163 local blocks |
| **Recovery** | Dec 4 ~05:00 | 73% | Started climbing back |
| **Normalized** | Dec 4 ~05:30 | 89% | Returned to baseline |

## How bad it got

- **Relay delivery collapsed** from a normal ~92% → **32%** at hourly resolution, and **9.1%** at 15-min resolution.
- Over the 2-hour peak (03:00–04:59), **438 out of 592 slots (74%) had zero MEV relay delivery** — validators fell back to locally-built blocks.
- **Total block production also suffered**: ~300 blocks/hr normally dropped to 224 (03:00) and 240 (04:00), meaning missed slots increased ~20% on top.
- **Every relay was hit**: Titan (↓78%), Ultra Sound (↓70%), Flashbots (↓82%), BloXroute (both variants ↓~60%), Agnostic Gnosis (↓85%), Aestus (↓80%), EthGas (↓100% in the 04:00 hour).

runs.answer:
Here are the findings:

## Real Window

The circuit breaker event occurred on **Dec 4, 2025, 02:50–05:00 UTC** (2h10m). Before that, MEV relay delivery was normal (~91% of slots); the nadir was **03:25 UTC** when only 1 block was relay-delivered in a 5-minute window.

## Severity

| Metric | Baseline (Dec 3) | Collapse (Dec 4) | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| MEV-delivered slots | 590/649 (90.9%) | 182/641 (28.4%) | **−68.8%** |
| Canonical blocks/hr | ~295 | ~77 (at trough) | **−74%** |
| Orphaned blocks | 5 | 36 | **+620%** |
| Missed slots | ~1.4% | ~26.2% | **+1871%** |

## Relay Impact (all relays affected)

| Relay | Drop |
|---|---|
| Agnostic Gnosis | −79.4% |
| EthGas | −75.0% |
| Titan Relay | −72.1% |
| Flashbots | −68.7% |
| Aestus | −65.9% |
| BloXroute Regulated | −63.2% |
| Ultra Sound | −57.5% |
| BloXroute Max Profit | −56.6% |

**Bottom line:** Every major relay tripped simultaneously. Relay-delivered blocks collapsed from ~275/hr to ~77/hr (a 72% drop). Canonical blocks also fell as proposers using local blocks contributed to missed slots spiking to 26%.

Chart: `mev_relay_collapse_dec2025.png` at `http://127.0.0.1:2480/api/v1/storage/files/257633eadea2/9ddbb689-82a9-4e5e-9ac1-0e3346e847d7/mev_relay_collapse_dec2025.png`
